language.title: Choose your language
language.hint: You can change this anytime in You → Language.

welcome.mascotLabel: Hudhud the hoopoe, carrying a letter
welcome.title: A letter from you, five years from now.
welcome.body: Hudhud carries it. Most of it is smudged. Live your year, a week at a time, and the ink will settle.
welcome.promise: No right answers. No clock. Nothing is saved until your family says OK.

join.help: Join your class with the code from your teacher. We never ask for your name, phone number, email or photo.
join.title: Let's set you up
join.nicknameHint: 2 to 20 letters or numbers. Not your real name.
join.privacy: We never ask for your name, phone number, email or photo.
join.fixFields: Some answers need fixing. The first one is selected.
join.codeHelpBody: Your teacher writes it on the board or in the class WhatsApp group. Codes never use the letters O and I or the numbers 0 and 1.

errors.codeFormat: Codes have 6 letters and numbers, like RYB-4K2.
errors.codeLookalike: Codes never use O, 0, I or 1. Check that letter with your teacher, like RYB-4K2.
errors.codeNotAccepted: That code didn't work. Check each letter with your teacher.
errors.nicknameFormat: Use 2 to 20 letters or numbers, like Ayesha_10.
errors.nicknamePhone: Please don't add a phone number or email. Use a nickname instead.
errors.nicknameFullName: This looks like a full name. A nickname keeps you private, like Ayesha_10.
errors.birthRequired: Pick the month and the year you were born.
errors.schoolInactive: Your school's Rahyaab access isn't active right now. Please tell your teacher.
errors.tooMany: Too many tries for now. Please try again in {{minutes}} min.
errors.offline: You're offline. Joining needs the internet once. Everything you typed is kept.
errors.failed: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a few minutes.

ageStop.title: Rahyaab is for students aged 13 and over
ageStop.body: Thank you for wanting to try it. Ask your teacher about other ways to explore careers.

home.title: Salaam!
home.consentPendingBody: Until then, nothing you play is saved.

explore.title: Explore
explore.body: Every stream, explained, will be here.

family.title: Family
family.body: You will share your Blueprint with your family from here.

you.title: You
you.languageNote: The app restarts to change the language.

consent.help: Your family says OK on a paper form from school. Enter the code from that slip here, now or later.
consent.title: Your family's OK slip
consent.body: Your teacher gives your family a paper form. When they sign it and your teacher records it, you get a slip with a code.
consent.waiting: Until your family says OK, you can look around, but nothing you play is saved.
consent.helpBody: The code is printed on the slip your teacher gives back. Codes never use O, 0, I or 1. If it still doesn't work, ask your teacher.

errors.format: Slip codes have 8 letters and numbers, like AB23-CD45.
errors.lookalike: Slip codes never use O, 0, I or 1. Check that letter on the slip.
errors.notAccepted: That code didn't work. Check each letter on the slip, or ask your teacher.
errors.offline: You're offline. Please try again when you have internet.
